messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service gateway-prod — HTTP 5xx rate > 15% in last 2m. Alert id PDR-78942. https://p.d/alerts/78942

pagerduty: Auto-page triggered to #incidents (severity: high). Escalation policy: primary -> SRE oncall.

Sam H.: Acked. I'm oncall, jumping in. Starting triage — checking ingress, kvcache and autoscaler.

Maria T.: Seeing customer 502 reports in US-WEST from support dashboard. Can someone confirm kvcache eviction spikes?

Leo (sre): Pulling gateway logs now. Quick grep for 5.. errors then kv metrics. Running:```kubectl -n infra logs -l app=gateway --tail=200 | rg "5.."```

Sam H.: kvcache.evictions{region="us-west"} = 120/s over the last minute. Autoscaler churning: scale events every ~30s.

Nina (support): Confirmed multiple customer tickets citing intermittent 502s; traffic sample shows ~18% 5xx for some endpoints. Marking customer impact: partial outage for ~20% of requests in us-west.

Sam H.: Temporarily enable routing fallback from us-west to us-east to blunt impact. Applying fallback (graceful):
```curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/routes/fallback -d '{"from":"us-west","to":"us-east","mode":"graceful"}'```

incident-bot: Route fallback request accepted (job id 83421). Change will roll out over 30s.

pagerduty: PDR-78942 acknowledged by Sam H. (primary).

Leo (sre): Observing high connection churn tied to a new canary model variant — excessive fanout and upstream resets. Suggest rollback of the canary to reduce load on gateway.

Sam H.: Rolling canary down to 0% now. Command:```redwoodctl rollout cancel --deployment gateway-canary --percentage 0```

Maria T.: After fallback + rollback, 5xx dropping — now ~4.2% in the last 2m. Continue to watch.

Nina (support): Sending customer status update: "We are mitigating a partial service disruption in US-WEST; traffic is being rerouted and a rollback is in progress."

Sam H.: Keep eyes on error rate and latency. If stable for 10m, I'll clear the page and create an RCA stub. If symptoms return, escalate to SRE secondary @Leo.

Infra Runner: Note for handoff: night oncall picks up at 00:30 UTC. If still open, please prepare short summary + trace IDs.

Leo (sre): Saving traces and example IDs: trace=tr_3f4a, reqid=ri_92ae. Will attach logs to the incident.

Sam H.: Thanks team — monitoring. :thumbsup:

(10m later) Sam H.: 5xx steady ~1.1% and customer reports dropping. I'm going to resolve the alert in PD and follow up with an RCA tomorrow. Closing actions: remove temporary fallback after confirming kvcache fix in canary infra, investigate autoscaler oscillation, and add kvcache eviction alarm threshold.

pagerduty: PDR-78942 resolved by Sam H.

Nina (support): Customers notified that service is recovering. Will reopen tickets if they surface new errors.

Leo (sre): Leaving notes for RCA: root cause likely canary-induced backend fanout causing kvcache thrash + autoscaler feedback loop. Will draft details.
